SpecialThingFilterDef.description: Non-organic corpses unsuitable for biomass extraction.

RecipeDef.label: extract biomass from corpse
RecipeDef.description: Convert a whole organic corpse into raw biomass. Recovery is based on remaining biological material, with 25% additional biomass from organs, bones and hide. This bonus also applies to damaged bodies. Rotting corpses yield 50% and desiccated corpses 10% of fresh recovery, with a minimum of 1 raw biomass per eligible corpse. Processing work scales with remaining material; larger bodies benefit from batch efficiency. By default, 30% of work handles the body regardless of decay, while 70% scales with recovery. Rotting bodies therefore take 65% and desiccated bodies 37% of fresh processing time. Corpse timings can be changed under Raw Biomass in GeneFoundry's mod settings. Clothing and equipment are stripped before extraction; special butcher products such as horns and tusks are recovered using their body-part definitions. Installed artificial parts are removed first using medical work. Each recoverable item has one recovery attempt: success salvages it, failure destroys it. Recovery uses vanilla surgery factors and skill requirements but consumes no medicine and ignores cleanliness. The operator must meet the applicable surgery skill requirements. Artificial parts without a defined removal item are discarded. Animal corpses are selected by default; other organic corpses require enabling them in the ingredient filter.
